name: Poznań Town Hall (Ratusz) & Old Market Square
description: Renaissance town hall famous for its mechanical Billy Goats that butt heads every day at noon.

name: Cathedral Basilica of St. Peter and St. Paul (Ostrów Tumski)
description: One of the oldest churches in Poland and the burial place of the first Polish rulers on Cathedral Island.

name: Brama Poznania ICHOT (Interactive Heritage Center)
description: Modern interactive museum presenting the history of Cathedral Island with multimedia exhibits.

name: Stary Browar (Old Brewery Art & Business Center)
description: Award-winning shopping and art gallery center built inside a revitalized 19th-century brewery.

name: Rogalowe Muzeum Poznania (Croissant Museum)
description: Live interactive show where visitors help bake traditional St. Martin croissants and learn local dialect.

name: Cytadela Park & Open-Air Sculptures
description: Huge green park on the site of a former fortress featuring walking paths, bike lanes, and Magdalena Abakanowicz sculptures.

name: National Museum in Poznań (Muzeum Narodowe)
description: Major art museum housing Polish and European paintings, including works by Claude Monet and Jan Matejko.

name: Lake Malta & Malta Ski Recreational Area
description: Scenic artificial lake ideal for cycling, rowing events, sports activities, and family walks.

name: Imperial Castle (CK Zamek Cultural Centre)
description: Monumental palace built in 1910 for Emperor William II, now hosting exhibitions, cinema, and concerts.

name: Poznań Palm House (Palmiarnia Poznańska)
description: One of the largest botanical glasshouses in Europe with exotic plants, aquariums, and surrounding Wilson Park.

name: Bałtyk Tower
description: Iconic modern office building designed by MVRDV that looks different from every angle, with a panoramic restaurant on the top floors.

name: Śródka District & 3D Mural 'A Tale of Śródka'
description: Charming historic neighborhood famous for its giant 3D street art mural and cozy cafes.

name: ENEA Poznań City Stadium
description: Home stadium of Lech Poznań football club, offering guided tours of the locker rooms and pitch.

name: New Zoo Poznań (Nowe Zoo)
description: Spacious zoological garden set in forested hills with a mini-train for families and children.

name: Wartostrada Cycling & Walking Route
description: Dedicated paved cycling and pedestrian path running alongside the Warta River through scenic parks.
